notes.title: Our First Major Update Since the Latest Demo Release!
notes.content:
[h3]First up, the biggest change: a complete graphical rework![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917373/d0f3dec373d502d021a13f709935d3255e10d5aa.png[/img]

All in-game elements have been revamped with more vibrant colors and detailed visuals, giving the game a much more polished and professional look. While this update features a partial rework—since some assets are still in progress—the final version of the game will include the full overhaul.

[h3]The second exciting addition: Power-Ups![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917373/c85f91ea90b3733c7e7a9b20aea7ab7de6c58d60.png[/img]

We’ve added 4 unique power-ups to make each playthrough more dynamic and fun:

Clock Power-Up: Freezes time for a few seconds, giving you extra time to rack up points.

Grow Power-Up: Instantly grows all your plants to their final phase, ready for harvest—no matter if they need water, fertilizer, or have pests!

Speed Power-Up: Grants a temporary speed boost so you can race across the map with ease.

Dog Power-Up: Stops all the animals in their tracks for a short period, so they won’t get in your way.

With these two big updates and several bug fixes, our demo feels more dynamic and alive than ever!
